Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (6 points, ~6% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.193), which favours a robust combination.
